issue_context.title: [wasm][debugger] Evaluation of functions returning char
comments:
Tagging subscribers to 'arch-wasm': @lewing See info in area-owners.md if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
Reproduction code: ``` private void IncrementCount() { var test = new TestClass(); currentCount++; } public class TestClass { public char GetPassedChar(char param) => param; public char GetChar() => 'G'; public bool GetTrueIfPassedA(char param) => param == 'A' ? true : false; } ``` Behavior: Functions that return character (in debugger called *symbol*) are not supported yet, as on the screenshot below. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32700855/153178583-6dcc5946-e8d3-4f15-9481-150f1dd97e56.png) log: [11:10:09] fail: Microsoft.WebAssembly.Diagnostics.DevToolsProxy[0] sending error response for id: msg-:::110 -> [Result: IsOk: False, IsErr: True, Value: , Error: { "message": "Evaluate of this datatype symbol not implemented yet" } ] Where to fix: ConvertJSToCSharpLocalVariableAssignment() function in EvaluateExpression.cs. There is no case "symbol" so function returning character land in default option that throws an error. Either add another case for symbols or use string code for chars.
